assessment: Here Prota et al. compare the action of the microtubule-stabilizing agent, taxol, with that of closely-related analogues and, as a result, successfully dissect the interactions and roles of different regions of the taxol molecule. The overall story is solid, providing new molecular insights, including defining and separating the lattice expansion effect from the lattice stabilization effect upon taxane binding. This important work will be of interest to the microtubule cytoskeleton and structural biology communities.
